assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are suggestive of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
CPT 93271 corresponds to Cardiac Event Monitoring
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I34.0, and I49.5
The PR-204 determination states that this service is not covered
The claim is for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271)
The determination is based on Reason Code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
